deslop.reason: Host authorization for command execution (deslop#74, deslop#75). These runners and probes take a required authorizeExecution callback and deny any launch without it, through deslop's own lib/utils/command-execution.js. The shared copies run without a callback, and perf (scripts/perf-phase.js), next-task (/next-task policy) and agentsys tests call them that way, so the change cannot move into the shared lib until those callers pass one.
